query:
SELECT 
  YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(date, '%Y-%m-%d')) as year,
  COUNT(*) as event_count,
  GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(titleEn, ' (', category, ')') SEPARATOR ' | ') as events
FROM events
GROUP BY YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(date, '%Y-%m-%d'))
ORDER BY year;
